name: Pride and humility
text: Pride goes before a fall; humility, the humble are raised up and the proud brought low.

passages.text: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
